# Skelenote Contributor License Agreement

Thank you for contributing to Skelenote!

## Why a CLA?

The CLA ensures:

- You have the legal right to contribute the code
- Skelenote can continue to be distributed under its license
- Your contribution won't create legal issues for users

## Agreement

By signing this agreement, you accept and agree to the following terms:

### 1. Definitions

"Contribution" means any original work of authorship, including modifications
to existing work, that you submit to the Skelenote project.

### 2. Grant of Copyright License

You grant to Jordan Stella and users of Skelenote a perpetual, worldwide,
non-exclusive, royalty-free, irrevocable copyright license to reproduce,
prepare derivative works, publicly display, sublicense, and distribute your
Contributions.

### 3. Grant of Patent License

You grant to Jordan Stella and users a perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive,
royalty-free, irrevocable patent license to make, use, sell, and import your
Contributions.

### 4. Representations

- You have the legal right to grant these licenses
- Your Contribution is your original work
- Your employer (if applicable) has waived rights to your Contribution

### 5. No Obligation

You are not obligated to provide support for your Contributions.

## How to Sign

Comment on your pull request:

> I have read the CLA and agree to its terms

The CLA bot will record your agreement. This is a one-time process.
